dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Multiple thin, high-contrast pale horizontal bands visible across the tips of the greater and median covert feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent with sharp, distinct pale whitish boundaries along the outer edges of the dark folded primaries and secondaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely pronounced scaly pattern across the mantle and wings created by dark feather centers and wide pale-buff margins.
